title: Slack (send messages)
description: Sends a flow's message to a Slack channel through a Slack app's bot token: a message.send connector, the last step of a flow that runs on its own. Text only.
setup_notes: Create a Slack app at api.slack.com/apps, add the chat:write scope under OAuth & Permissions, install it to your workspace and copy the Bot User OAuth Token (it starts xoxb-). Invite the app to the channel (/invite @your-app). The channel id is in the channel's details, at the bottom. Run Test on its row under Admin > Extensions > Connectors, which posts a short test message. Then put it to use as a flow's message.send step. Its key is given where it is used, under the choice, or under Settings on its row in Admin > Extensions > Connectors.

questions.name: name
questions.label: Connector name
questions.help: Lowercase letters, digits, dashes and underscores; a flow's step names it.

config.name: channel
config.label: Channel id
config.help: Where messages go unless a flow's step says otherwise (its to input), e.g. C0123456789.

config.name: bot_token
config.label: Bot User OAuth Token
config.help: Kept with this connection, and sent only to the address it is given for.
